question: Apart from ILPA's own publications and the PRI covering note, which documents in the corpus refer to ILPA, and for what purpose?
gold_answer: Four documents. (1) Arizona PSPRS investment consultant RFP: consultant databases of managers' deal histories should include the portfolio metrics ILPA recommends for collection. (2) Missouri LAGERS private markets consultant RFP: asks whether ILPA principles and guidelines are applied in sourcing and due diligence. (3) NYC BERS RFP 2024-003: the consultant must give ILPA transaction types per the ILPA Capital Call & Distribution Notice Template and keep cash-flow records on that basis. (4) NJEDA Life Science Seed Fund DDQ, Q7.3: asks whether the respondent's standard reporting package will be modelled on ILPA Reporting Best Practices.
acceptance: Accept the four documents and purposes; template title/transaction classification may be paraphrased.
candidate_answer:
Apart from ILPA’s publications and the PRI covering note, I found three documents that explicitly refer to ILPA:

| Document | Purpose of the reference |
|---|---|
| **NJEDA Life Science Seed Fund due-diligence questionnaire**, p. 5 | Asks prospective fund managers whether their proposed reporting package will follow **ILPA Reporting Best Practices**. |
| **Missouri LAGERS Private Market Consultant RFP**, p. 13 | Asks bidders whether they apply **ILPA principles and guidelines** when sourcing and conducting due diligence on investments. |
| **NYC BERS Investment Consulting Services RFP**, p. 14 | Uses the **ILPA Capital Call & Distribution Notice Template** as a standard for classifying private-market cash flows. The consultant must supply ILPA transaction types where available and maintain records using those types, subject to the manager’s preparation of the template. |
